name: 基础设施情况
description: 从 Grafana 面板迁移并汉化，已转换为“我的面板”原生格式。来源：infrastructure。

variables.name: cluster_id
variables.label: 集群
variables.query:
SELECT DISTINCT scope_id AS __value, 
CASE 
  WHEN c.name != '' THEN c.name
  ELSE scope_id
END AS __text
FROM data_scope 
LEFT JOIN clusters c ON scope_id  = c.id
WHERE type = 'cluster'

variables.name: service_type
variables.label: 查询方式
variables.query: 按K8s查询 : .*, 按虚机查询 :  ,

variables.name: service_name
variables.label: 服务
variables.query: query_result(group by (svc_name) (kindling_span_trace_duration_nanoseconds_count{vm="$service_type", cluster_id=~"$cluster_id"}) or group by (svc_name) (kindling_span_trace_duration_nanoseconds_count{pod=~"$pod",namespace=~"$namespace", cluster_id=~"$cluster_id"}))

variables.name: related_nodes
variables.label: 相关节点
variables.query: query_result( group by (node_name) (container_memory_rss{job_name="integrations/kubernetes/cadvisor",pod=~"$pod",pod!="", cluster_id=~"$cluster_id"}) or group by (node_name) ( kindling_span_trace_duration_nanoseconds_count{svc_name="$service_name",svc_name!="", cluster_id=~"$cluster_id"}))
